name: Kimberly R. Willoughby
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Golden, Colorado
education: University of Virginia School of Law
about: Kimberly R. Willoughby has been practicing law in Colorado for over 25 years. She started the Willoughby Law Firm, LLC, in 1996 which became Willoughby & Associates. Ms. Willoughby limits her practice to the area of family law and estate planning. Ms. Willoughby is also admitted to practice in South Dakota.

After graduating magna cum laude from the University of Colorado at Boulder, Ms. Willoughby received her law degree from the University of Virginia in 1994. She is AV Preeminent rated by Martindale Hubbell, has been named a Colorado Super Lawyer since 2006. She has been named as a Top Lawyer in 5280 Magazine, and she has been named in Best Lawyers in America since 2006. She has presented and written extensively in the family law and estate planning fields. A full bio can be found at www.willoughbylaw.com.

Kim helps families in transition navigate some of life's most challenging periods with exceptional representation and legal advice. Kim's area of emphasis is complex litigation cases involving the nexus between death and divorce, including divorces where intergenerational wealth is an issue. Kim's practice also has a strong planning component, especially in the area of prenuptial agreements.
Willoughby and Associates is located in beautiful Genesee, Colorado, just west of the Metro area at 25188 Genesee Trail Road in Golden.

*AV Preeminent and BV Distinguished are registered certification marks of Reed Elsevier Properties Inc., used in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell is the facilitator of a peer review rating process. Ratings reflect the confidential opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell ratings fall into two categories: legal ability and general ethical standards.
